tldr: Venus through the 6th house softens work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Venus moves through your 6th house, it draws your attention toward work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
